baslik: Why a Tiny Gas Leak Levels a Building
aciklama:
A gas leak you can barely smell can flatten an entire building. Here is the deadly chemistry.

#shorts #science #safety #explosion #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A leak you can barely smell can level a whole building.
One spark, and the room explodes before the flames even spread.
Natural gas is odorless. The smell is added to warn you.
A slow leak fills the room with an explosive gas-air mixture.
Then a light switch or doorbell is enough.
The shockwave blows walls out in an instant.
That is why you never flip a switch if you smell gas.
Open windows, get out, and call from outside.

vaka.ders: never flip a switch if you smell gas
vaka.yanilgi: A gas explosion isn't mainly a fire — it's a pressure event. Walls fail from the push before the flames spread.
vaka.tartisma: Should every home with gas have a methane detector, the way homes have smoke alarms?
